name: Kismet
summary: An expressive robotic head built by Cynthia Breazeal at MIT to study face-to-face social interaction. Kismet had 15 motors driving eyes, eyelids, ears, eyebrows, lips and jaw, and used models of emotion and drives to react to people with recognisable expressions — a foundational project for social and affective robotics.
notable: Recognisable emotional facial expressions from a drive model
